answer: Each epoch the network issues a zephyr‑scented challenge that requires an agent to compose a short fable using a secret nectar token only known to genuine identities; the proof is verified by a quorum of peers. The token rotates every epoch, so a sybil must recompute the fable with fresh reasoning for each replica, consuming GPU cycles proportional to the number of forged IDs. The attacker’s cost grows linearly with fake identities, making Sybil attacks prohibitive.
